TRUCK DETENTION PAY CALCULATOR · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

How much detention are you owed?

Enter your gate times and the terms from the rate confirmation. You get the billable detention hours, the dollars, what the wait did to your real hourly pay, and a claim email to paste to the broker. Time spent waiting is the most commonly unbilled money in trucking; this makes the claim a two-minute job.

Nothing is uploaded. Your times and rates are read in this browser and never leave your device.

What this does not cover

  • Your contract decides. If the rate confirmation has no detention clause, the broker is not obliged to pay; this tool cannot tell you what you agreed to.
  • Hours, not law. It does arithmetic on the times and terms you enter. It does not check them against a document.
  • Layover, TONU and lumper fees are separate accessorials and are not calculated here.

Common questions

How much detention can an owner-operator charge?

Whatever the rate confirmation says. The usual terms are two hours of free time, then $40 to $100 an hour billed in 15 or 30 minute increments, often capped at 8 to 12 hours. Check the rate confirmation: if it is silent, you are negotiating, not claiming, and the broker is not obliged to pay.

When does the detention clock start?

Usually at the later of your arrival time and the appointment time. Arriving early does not start it. If you arrive after the appointment, it starts when you arrive. This calculator reads each stop that way.

What proof do brokers want for a detention claim?

Signed or stamped in and out times from the bill of lading or a gate receipt, the rate confirmation showing the detention terms, and your request sent inside the broker's window, often 24 to 72 hours after delivery or with the proof of delivery. Photograph the times before you leave.

Is detention pay taxable?

Yes. It is ordinary business income, reported with the rest of your freight revenue. This tool only totals the claim; it does not compute tax.

Is this legal or financial advice?

No. It does arithmetic on the times and terms you enter. Whether a claim is owed depends on your contract, which this tool has not read.

We do not promise uptime, backups of anything you type, or that a URL will keep working. Do not use this as a system of record — nothing you enter is saved anywhere by this tool.

Everything runs in your browser. Your times and rates are never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (detention_calculated, example_loaded, claim_copied) are counted only in local storage on your device. The counts can be deleted with the button below. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are honoured.
